ImageDescription.value: Macau Tourism office is located in the building to the left. The entire area opposite the office, i.e. Senado Square proper, is set in white and black tiles, patterned to resemble a flowing river. Tourists from all nationalities were here, China, Japan, India, Europe etc. Neon pink wind jackets and grandma style glasses were the rage at this time, in HK as well as here, as the girl in the foreground shows. Jan/ Feb. 2012.
